recovery_scanner.reason: A recovery scanner exists in this Wave only as an invariant validator over durable documents (workstreams/po03/tools/validate_contracts.py validate-dir), not as a live daemon that leases, heartbeats and re-dispatches. No queue, lease store or outbox service was stood up, because Wave A ran one sequential worker with no subordinate dispatch route available.

lease_and_fence_mechanism.detail: Lease ids and fence tokens are recorded per unit in control/work-unit-registry.jsonl and validated structurally by the seeded result contract (fence_token integer >= 1, non-empty lease_id, monotonic checkpoint_seq). Their stale-writer semantics are tested at the document level in workstreams/po03/tests/test_validate_contracts.py, not against a live concurrent writer, because only one writer existed.
lease_and_fence_mechanism.monotonicity_verified: fence tokens 1..10 assigned strictly increasing, asserted by workstreams/po03/tests/test_control_evidence.py

live_fault_injection.reason: No live fault injection against real unreliable infrastructure was performed this session. There was no multi-process or multi-machine channel to interrupt: no subordinate dispatch tool is exposed to this worker, so no process loss, lost return message, stale-lease takeover, duplicate callback or provider-runtime loss could be induced against a real second party. What was exercised is unit-test-level invariant checking over durable custody documents, which falsifies the state machine's rules but not the transport.
what_was_exercised: provider COMPLETED without a durable result commit must be PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED (test_provider_completion_without_commit_is_reclassified)
committed results require manifest, hashes, byte reconciliation and artifact read-back (multiple tests)
the manifest detects any byte drift under workstreams/po03/ (test_verify_detects_modified_content)
a symlink cannot import outside content into the manifest (test_symlink_content_is_never_hashed_into_the_manifest)
a rename out of the allowlist is detected when rename detection is disabled (test_rename_out_of_the_allowlist_is_caught_without_rename_detection)
live_fault_injection.residual_risk: The changed-path guard passes vacuously on an empty changed-path set. If base resolution ever yields a commit identical to HEAD, the guard reports PASS 0 paths in scope rather than failing. This is recorded rather than repaired because a hard non-empty requirement would break legitimate re-runs of an unchanged commit; the workflow prints the resolved base and the full diff so a reviewer can see the input the guard received.

crash_recovery_position.restart_input: workstreams/po03/evidence/criteria-freeze.json plus workstreams/po03/evidence/source-lock.json pin the immutable input and acceptance criteria; workstreams/po03/control/work-unit-registry.jsonl records per-unit terminal state and commit id.
crash_recovery_position.resume_rule: A restarted controller re-reads the registry, treats any unit whose result_commit_id is not a real commit as unfinished, and re-executes it from the frozen input. Units with a real commit id are recoverable by SHA and must not be re-run.
crash_recovery_position.verification: workstreams/po03/tests/test_control_evidence.py asserts every recorded 40-hex commit id resolves to a real commit object in this repository, so the resume rule cannot be satisfied by a fabricated id.
